# Exit codes

## bootstrap.sh

`bootstrap.sh` ends with one of these codes. Codes 0, 1 and 2 are the exit code of `pinka doctor`, which runs last; codes 10 to 40 come from the preflight gate. Re-running bootstrap after any of them resumes cleanly.

| Code | Constant | Title | Meaning | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `EXIT_OK` | Success | Bootstrap finished and doctor reports no warnings | [Exit code 0](../how-to/troubleshoot.md#exit-code-0) |
| 1 | `EXIT_DOCTOR_WARNINGS` | Doctor warnings | Bootstrap finished; doctor reports warnings only | [Exit code 1](../how-to/troubleshoot.md#exit-code-1) |
| 2 | `EXIT_DOCTOR_FAILURES` | Doctor failures | Bootstrap finished; doctor reports failed checks | [Exit code 2](../how-to/troubleshoot.md#exit-code-2) |
| 10 | `EXIT_DEGRADED` | Degraded | Preflight found optional features missing and there was no consent (--accept-degraded or interactive confirmation) | [Exit code 10](../how-to/troubleshoot.md#exit-code-10) |
| 11 | `EXIT_EXPERIMENTAL` | Experimental | The host is on an experimental tier and there was no consent (--accept-experimental or interactive confirmation) | [Exit code 11](../how-to/troubleshoot.md#exit-code-11) |
| 20 | `EXIT_UNSUPPORTED` | Unsupported | Preflight or pre-preflight found the host unsupported and --force-unsupported was not given | [Exit code 20](../how-to/troubleshoot.md#exit-code-20) |
| 30 | `EXIT_NEEDS_ACTION` | Needs action | An operator action is needed before bootstrap can continue; the remediation is printed | [Exit code 30](../how-to/troubleshoot.md#exit-code-30) |
| 40 | `EXIT_PREFLIGHT_ERROR` | Preflight error | Host detection failed unexpectedly; the traceback is in the log | [Exit code 40](../how-to/troubleshoot.md#exit-code-40) |
| 50 | `EXIT_TOOLING` | Tooling failed | Installing uv, CPython, the Ansible environment or the Ansible collections failed, or a checksum did not match | [Exit code 50](../how-to/troubleshoot.md#exit-code-50) |
| 60 | `EXIT_ANSIBLE` | Play failed | An Ansible play failed without a bootstrap signal, or a later stage is not installed yet | [Exit code 60](../how-to/troubleshoot.md#exit-code-60) |
| 64 | `EXIT_USAGE` | Usage error | Invalid command-line options | [Exit code 64](../how-to/troubleshoot.md#exit-code-64) |
| 70 | `EXIT_INTERNAL` | Internal error | Unexpected error in bootstrap itself; the failing line is in the log | [Exit code 70](../how-to/troubleshoot.md#exit-code-70) |
| 75 | `EXIT_WSL_RESTART` | WSL restart required | Run 'wsl --terminate &lt;distro&gt;' on the Windows side, then re-run bootstrap | [Exit code 75](../how-to/troubleshoot.md#exit-code-75) |
| 76 | `EXIT_REBOOT` | Reboot required | Reboot (and enroll the MOK if asked), then re-run bootstrap | [Exit code 76](../how-to/troubleshoot.md#exit-code-76) |
| 77 | `EXIT_OPERATOR` | Operator action required | The printed message says what to do (for example run as root, commit the infra tree, accept a changed host profile) | [Exit code 77](../how-to/troubleshoot.md#exit-code-77) |

## pinka-preflight

The exit code is the outcome of the support-matrix decision (see [Support matrix](../support-matrix.md)).

| Code | Outcome | Meaning | Bootstrap behavior |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `supported` | All core requirements met; features computed. | Bootstrap continues. |
| 10 | `degraded` | Core requirements met, one or more optional features unavailable. | Bootstrap continues only with --accept-degraded or interactive confirmation that lists every disabled feature and its research impact. |
| 20 | `unsupported` | A core requirement failed, the OS, architecture or environment is unsupported, or a blocking conflict exists. | Bootstrap aborts; --force-unsupported continues and records overrides.force_unsupported in the host profile and every environment fingerprint. |
| 30 | `needs_action` | Fixable by operator action (reboot, wsl --terminate, enroll MOK, remove a conflict). | Bootstrap prints the exact remediation steps and aborts; re-run after the action. |
| 40 | `preflight_error` | Detection itself failed unexpectedly. | Bootstrap aborts with the traceback in the log. |

## pinka

`pinka preflight` passes the exit code of pinka-preflight through. See [Doctor checks](doctor-checks.md) for the severity of every check.

| Code | Command | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `pinka doctor` | every check passed or was skipped |
| 1 | `pinka doctor` | only checks of severity warning failed |
| 2 | `pinka doctor` | a check of severity error failed, or doctor could not run |
| 0 | other commands | success |
| 1 | other commands | failure; the message says why |
| 2 | any | usage error (unknown command or option) |
